about: Links (add_offmesh.py) for Hibernian dungeons the modern (1.130 live geometry) meshes left in pieces. Koalinth Caverns: the upper and lower levels meet at one 32-unit step. Fomor: 9 of 74 climbs end on false floor inside solid pillars; each link joins the real floors at that climb's foot and top. Treibh Caillte is left out: its floors join only through RockyGolem teleporters. Apply to the installed modern meshes, then regenerate the dungeon proofs with UT_DungeonProofGenerator. These zones have no seams, roads or pockets entries.
